name: Storm Control
description: The heavens are a raging tempest that may only be calmed by the stillness in the sky serpent's heart.
effect: Followers of Rayquaza may call upon 'Storm Control' once per quest as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to cast a weather of their choice. This weather can still be overridden, and ties should still be rolled in the case of an already active weather. At Luminary, if the user's weather is ended for any reason they may expend 1 Will and keep a personalized effect of that Weather, causing the weather to affect only themselves for four additional turns. At Paragon, they may choose to have the weather affect any target when they cause its personalized effect to come into effect, though it only lasts two turns. At High Priest(ess), the Paragon effect lasts the full four turns.
